features.name: comptime_contract_graph
features.contract: Validate bounded contract schemas, dependency versions and required fields; emit dependency-first lexical topological order; reject cycles before a compiler backend emits code.

features.name: arena_slot
features.contract: Allocate from caller-owned fixed storage with checked power-of-two alignment; reset at frame end and optionally zeroize the used range.

features.name: budget_worker
features.contract: Cooperatively check monotonic CPU time and accounted memory at explicit checkpoints; halt further checkpoints and expose a bounded state dump on overrun.
features.execution: cooperative; hard preemption is delegated to a host process/scheduler

features.name: diff_reconcile_plan
features.contract: Build a deterministic aggregate-only plan with noop, upsert and drop entries after invariant preflight. The API never applies the plan or connects to persistence.

features.name: ephemeral_match
features.contract: Compare fixed-size digests in caller-owned transient scope memory and wipe the entire scope buffer on close.

features.name: mutation_authorization
features.contract: Require a passing validator for automatic mode, or a host-validated opaque grant tied to the current revision for manual mode; return revision metadata only.

features.name: lease_window
features.contract: Represent a UTC-day validity interval as a typed value, enforce a 1..120 day literal bound and report warning/expiry states.

features.name: latency_profiler
features.contract: Collect fixed-size phase histograms and return approximate bucketed p95/p99 summaries without allocation or background agents.

features.name: local_only_effect_boundary
features.contract: Reject network and remote-I/O effects in local-only modules, including transitively imported effects aggregated by the compiler.

features.name: rollback_plan
features.contract: Require monotonic schema versions and distinct forward/reverse step identifiers, with passing tests for both directions.
